origin: Original user-directed built-in image generation, security-room-menu-v1; not taken from another mod.
note: Generated art has incidental partial alpha outside screen holes. An opaque black underlay prevents vanilla background bleed. Rounded apertures mask the animated textures.
animation: Eight deterministic original grayscale 64x48 textures authored by scripts/generate_menu_static.py; Lua owns independent timing.

ultrawide.layout: Continuous room with an expanded right field of view. Desk is reframed toward the center-left; the same wall paint boundary, pipe, baseboard and floor perspective continue into the open right area. Uniform top-aligned cover scaling focuses narrow crops on the menu/desk group and reveals more right scenery at ultrawide ratios. No separate panels.
ultrawide.origin: Original built-in image edits of the owned room; current dev9 pipe refinement extends the highest run to the left image edge and removes the old left ascent/lower segment. Generated PNG used unchanged; no external artwork.
ultrawide.decoration: Far-left vent and smaller footlocker/folders; clear wall for logo/menu. Right bunker furniture retained in the same composition.

menu_wall.note: Lua lays out dynamic menu entries inside this clear wall; these are internal image coordinates.
